description.text: Scholarship Policy According to the strategy cooperation agreement between SICAS and University of Jinan, the students who get admission in this major through SICAS only have to pay CNY18,000/Year instead of CNY 28,000 /Year from the second year and the third year. The first year is not included. The scholarship will directly to reduce the tuition, not cash. Special Scholarship for SICAS International Students in University of Jinan (click to apply) Degree Award Students are required to complete the curriculum in 2.5, fulfill the designated degree courses, complete the master's thesis and defend of it in front of a panel of experts. Graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the Master’s degree.

duration.text: The Chemical Science and Engineering at University of Jinan is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3722 USD/per year ￥ 26800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. application form 2. personal resume 3. scanned copy of passport 4. Graduation certificate or Bachelor’s Degree 5. Bachelor’s Degree Transcript 6. Study Plan in University of Jinan 7. Two letters of recommendation from two associate professors or higher 8. Certificate for new HSK

requirements.text: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. Hold a Bachelor's degree. Certificate of HSK 6.
